name: OrangeTee & Tie
summary: Property agency network active across condo and landed rentals and sales — negotiate tenant-side fees in writing and confirm stamp-duty reimbursement timing.
body: Agents are not interchangeable — interview for neighbourhood fluency, landlord relationships, and LOI discipline. OrangeTee is one of several large brands; chemistry with your individual agent matters more than logo. If you engage them as your tenant agent, document commission and renewal terms in a CEA prescribed agreement before the first viewing, and clarify that stamp-duty collection is reimbursement after stamping, not a pre-stamp cash grab. If you are comparing rent vs buy, ask for a written cash-flow sketch that includes ABSD (or FTA remission) rather than a mortgage-only spreadsheet. Landed listings for foreigners often have approval caveats — confirm eligibility before emotional deposits.
